properties.description:

The National Weather Service in La Crosse has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Fillmore County in southeastern Minnesota...
Southern Houston County in southeastern Minnesota...

* Until 215 PM CDT.

thunderstorms produced heavy rain across the warned area. Between 5

hours. Flash flooding is already occurring.

highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Grove, Beaver Creek Valley State Park, Dun Romin Park Campground,
